full_prompt_en: A Northern Renaissance oil painting shows three court figures in close overlapping profile against a nearly black background. All face left, their noses and brows forming a measured sequence of pale silhouettes from foreground to rear. The foremost woman wears an elaborate tall headdress embroidered with gold thread and set over deep turquoise fabric. Small jewels, dangling ornament, and a decorated collar extend the rich surface detail around her calm face. Behind her, two more figures wear darker red, green, and gold headpieces, their features progressively less prominent as they recede into shadow. The composition is tightly cropped so the repeated profiles and ceremonial textiles fill almost the entire picture; little surrounding room is visible. Faces are modeled in smooth translucent layers, with cool ivory highlights, warm peach shadows, and precise edges around eyelids, lips, and noses. The textiles are handled differently: tiny raised-looking dots, curled gold motifs, patterned bands, and dark woven areas produce a dense tactile richness. Light comes gently from the left and catches the nearest face and metallic embroidery, fading across the others. A restrained palette of ivory, antique gold, oxblood red, malachite green, and black keeps the ornament coherent. The contrast between serene, unembellished faces and intensely worked clothing creates a formal rhythm. The scene feels still and ceremonial, its intimacy coming from the close repeated silhouettes and the painter's patient attention to each minute surface.
full_prompt_zh: 一幅北方文艺复兴油画描绘三位宫廷人物在近黑背景前紧密重叠的侧脸。她们均面向左，鼻与眉从前至后形成有分寸的浅色剪影序列。最前方女子佩戴高而繁复的头饰，以金线刺绣，并覆于深青绿布上。小宝石、下垂饰物和装饰衣领在她平静的脸周围延续浓密表面细节。身后两人佩戴更深的红、绿、金头饰，五官随着退入阴影而逐渐不突出。构图紧裁，重复侧脸和礼仪织物几乎填满全幅；周围房间几乎不可见。脸由平滑半透明色层塑造，带冷象牙亮部、暖桃阴影，以及眼睑、唇和鼻周围精确边缘。织物处理则不同：微小似凸起点、卷曲金纹、花带与深织面构成浓密可触的丰厚感。光从左侧柔和而来，抓住近脸和金属刺绣，再逐渐淡过其余人物。象牙、旧金、牛血红、孔雀石绿和黑的克制配色让装饰统一。宁静无装饰的脸与极精工衣饰形成正式节奏。场景静止、具仪式感，其亲密来自贴近的重复剪影和画家对每个微小表面的耐心注视。
style_prompt_en: Northern Renaissance-style oil painting joins smooth translucent modeling with extraordinarily precise decorative surface work. A near-black ground makes layered pale forms and jewel-toned textiles appear luminous. Ivory, muted peach, antique gold, oxblood red, deep green, and small turquoise areas are arranged in compact, ordered bands. Contours remain fine and exact where lit planes meet dark ground, while shadowed layers recede softly. Minute dots, curled motifs, narrow borders, and woven marks enrich selected surfaces without obscuring their larger silhouettes. Gentle side light emphasizes the closest pale plane and catches metallic accents, then decreases gradually across overlapping depth. The composition has a tight repeated rhythm of similarly angled curves against a dense dark field. Fine glazing gives skin or smooth material quiet volume, contrasted with crisp ornament and tactile pattern. The result is formal, still, and lavishly observed rather than loose or theatrical.
style_prompt_zh: 北方文艺复兴式油画将平滑半透明塑造与异常精确的装饰表面工艺结合。近黑底色让层叠浅形与宝石色织物显得发亮。象牙、暗桃、旧金、牛血红、深绿和小片青绿以紧凑有序色带排列。受光平面接深底处轮廓细而准确，遮阴层则柔和退远。微小点、卷曲纹、窄边和编织笔痕丰富选定表面，却不掩盖其大剪影。柔侧光强调最近的浅平面并抓住金属点缀，然后随重叠深度逐渐减弱。构图在浓密暗场前形成相似倾角曲线的紧密重复节奏。细罩染赋予皮肤或光滑材质安静体积，对比清晰装饰与可触图案。结果正式、静止、观察华丽，而非松散或戏剧化。
theme_en: Three court figures in profile wear elaborate jewel-toned ceremonial headwear
theme_zh: 三位宫廷人物侧面并列，佩戴宝石色繁复礼帽
name: Jan Van Eyck
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
